seed: Objects of type `counter` under action ACTION4 with touching neighbours [] show mixed outcomes: no_change x10, tags,w,x x10. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Player 5x5 moves 5 per arrow; dest blocked if off-board or any colour 4/5 cell (blocked moves still burn).
Conveyor: 5-cell colour-1 strip just outside a dest edge slides the player away until blocked.
step_bar: 2 leftmost colour-11 cells -> 3 per arrow; covered refuel ring refills the track. Counter A4 mixed = hud_glyph vs step_bar.
Covered collect object rotates 3x3-of-2x2 HUD glyph 90 CW; sprite restored on uncover via frame-equality-gated memory.
Unobserved/hypothesis: chamber reject while glyph != legend; recolor token sets glyph colour 9.
